affected.note: 23,280 viewer present applicants, plus 142 people who submitted opinions or comments. The data was viewable from 2020-09-28 to 2023-09-21; remaining access logs from 2023-09-22 showed no outside access, and no misuse had been reported.

summary.en: Kochi Sun Sun Television found on 2023-11-09 that lists of viewer present applicants stored on its website could be viewed from outside by entering a specific URL. Names, addresses, phone numbers, email addresses and ages of 23,280 applicants were exposed.
summary.ja: 高知さんさんテレビは2023年11月9日、視聴者プレゼントの応募者名簿などがホームページ上に保存され、特定のURLを入力すると外部から閲覧できる状態だったことに気付いた。応募者23,280人の氏名、住所、電話番号、メールアドレス、年齢が閲覧可能だった。
